text: Given NinjaOne instance automation-script count exceeds dump_json_capped's 20000-char truncation threshold (e.g. 489 scripts), When ninjaone_get_automation_scripts(name_filter="Rewst (Windows)") is called, Then the result contains that script's id/name/language fields and is unaffected by truncation

Given the same over-threshold script list, When ninjaone_get_automation_scripts() is called with no name_filter, Then the result is byte-identical to the pre-change behavior (including any truncated/original_count markers)
Given a device with a large number of runnable scripts/actions, When ninjaone_get_device_scripting_options(device_id, name_filter="Rewst") is called, Then only name-matching entries are returned

Given an organization with the custom field ninja_run_as_user configured, When ninjaone_get_organization_custom_fields(organization_id) is called, Then the field's name and value are readable in the result
Given an organization with no custom fields configured at all, When the same tool is called, Then the result explicitly marks the field as absent, not an error and not a silent omission
